lines.zh: 靴子踩过碎石，我走得很稳。
lines.en: My boots crunch gravel and I keep steady.
I walk the slope and my quiver sways.

lines.zh: 我往高处去，那里看得远。
lines.en: I climb for height; the view is longer.
I keep my steps soft near the village.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥地，靴子不能湿。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; my boots must stay dry.

lines.zh: 弓背在身后，我走得不急。
lines.en: Bow on my back, I take my time.
I will look again from under that tree.

lines.zh: 我和同伴拉开距离前进。
lines.en: I advance at a distance from my kin.
Grass rustles and I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我沿着栅栏走，找准位置。
lines.en: I follow the fence line and pick a spot.

lines.zh: 我走路时肩膀一直在动。
lines.en: My shoulders never stop rolling as I walk.

lines.zh: 这一趟要走到能看见烟的地方。
lines.en: This trip takes me where smoke shows.
The quiver feels light; I weigh it.

lines.zh: 我拉了拉弦，听它的声音。
lines.en: I test the string and hear its note.
The wind comes from the left; noted.
Standing long, I shift onto the other foot.

lines.zh: 远处路口，我一刻没松眼。
lines.en: I have not taken my eyes off that crossing.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就理一理箭头。
lines.en: No one comes, so I sort my arrowheads.
My fingers tap softly on the bow.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看太阳的位置。
lines.en: I check where the sun sits in the sky.
I pull the hood to my brow to cut the glare.

lines.zh: 这份安静让我不太舒服。
lines.en: This quiet makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正在我的射程里。
lines.en: Where you stand is inside my range.
Your height gives me something to calculate.
Keep your hands from rising too high.

lines.zh: 你不是村民，我认得出来。
lines.en: You are no villager; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我在你背后的坡上看你。
lines.en: I watch you from the slope behind.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的准星跟着动。
lines.en: Each step you take moves my aim.

lines.zh: 眼熟，我见过你这种装备。
lines.en: That gear looks familiar to me.
There is still a stretch between us.
You finally turned; I waited a while.
Next time, I will draw before you speak.
The arrow never left; my hand shook.
I press my ribs and fall back behind a tree.

lines.zh: 被这一下打断，手都乱了。
lines.en: That hit broke my rhythm and my hands.
I grit my teeth and nock again.

lines.zh: 弦上沾了血，拉起来打滑。
lines.en: Blood on the string makes my draw slip.
I drop to one knee, then rise.
Stay back; I can still draw.
My shoulder is hurt; I cannot raise it.
It hurts, but less than shame.
My breathing is loud; I cannot hide.
Food? I already carry dry rations.

lines.zh: 你举着苹果，我可不上当。
lines.en: You wave an apple; I am not fooled.
Only good arrows interest me.
Stop waving it; I do not fall for that.
Emeralds, though, we could discuss.

lines.zh: 我的手在箭袋上，不在你手里。
lines.en: My hand is on my quiver, not your gift.
That smell does not pull at me.
My belly is empty; my head is not.
Set it down and walk back three steps.
Put it away; I am still working.
You knocked my aim off line.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我习惯远着打。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; I fight from afar.
I blocked with my elbow; move aside.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你就进了我的近身圈。
lines.en: Bump me and you enter my short range.
Knocked off balance, I shift back into place.
Your shield scraped against my bow.
This close, the bow works poorly.
I push you off without much force.

lines.zh: 撞过来的人，通常先倒下。
lines.en: Those who charge usually fall first.
I plant my feet and do not budge.
We do not do that; be on your way.

lines.zh: 掠夺者之间不结这种伴。
lines.en: Pillagers do not pair off like that.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在那边，别误会。
lines.en: My kin are over there; do not misunderstand.
I only draw bows; nothing else.
Stand back; I dislike being leaned on.
This conversation ends here.
You have the wrong one; ask someone else.
I hold my bow across my chest.
There is no such custom in our ranks.
Do not come closer or I will call out.
This arrow is still good; I keep it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，归捡到的人。
lines.en: What falls on the ground belongs to finders.
I bend and pick up the broken arrow.
Emeralds? I tuck them in my inner pocket.
The fletching is bent; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看看是谁的标记。
lines.en: I pick it up to read whose mark it bears.

lines.zh: 有用的我拿，没用的留下。
lines.en: I take what is useful and leave the rest.
Too heavy; I will not carry it.
I find an arrow with blood on it.
Stowed away, it can be traded later.

lines.zh: 你露头了，我等这一刻很久。
lines.en: You showed yourself; I waited for this.
The moving one is mine to handle.

lines.zh: 你手上那把东西，我看见了。
lines.en: That thing in your hand; I saw it.
The range is right and so is the wind.

lines.zh: 你挡在路中间，那就别怪箭。
lines.en: You block the road; blame the arrow.
I raise a hand and my kin halt.
Target set; I breathe in slowly.

lines.zh: 那个穿铁甲的，先解决他。
lines.en: The one in iron; he goes first.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就不打算放手。
lines.en: Now that I see you, I will not let go.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在地上，很清楚。
lines.en: Your shadow lies plain on the ground.
There is movement behind that tree.
I nock an arrow without a sound.
It looked up; I hold my breath.
At this distance I am confident.

lines.zh: 它转过来了，我的弦也拉满。
lines.en: It turns toward me, and my string is already full

lines.zh: 心里数完三下，箭就离弦。
lines.en: Three counts inside my head and the arrow flies.
Half a breath held and the string settles.

lines.zh: 你向左，我就往右偏一点。
lines.en: You go left; I aim a little right.
The wind drifted; I adjust half a notch.

lines.zh: 准星贴上你锁骨的位置。
lines.en: My sight rests just under your collarbone.
Almost there; let it stand still.

lines.zh: 手指松开之前，世界很静。
lines.en: Before I loose, the world is quiet.
It hides behind a shield; I aim low.

lines.zh: 我在算它下一步往哪走。
lines.en: I am reading where it will step next.
String at full draw, my shoulder tightens.
Do not hurry me; hurry bends the shot.
It has not looked up; that saves me trouble.
I ease my weight forward, slowly.
This arrow has to finish it in one.

lines.zh: 我蹲在坡上，等它走出草。
lines.en: I crouch on the slope and wait for it to leave the grass

lines.zh: 它每动一下，准头就换一格。
lines.en: Every time it moves, my aim shifts a notch

lines.zh: 我侧头看风，再低头看它。
lines.en: I check the wind, then look back down at it

lines.zh: 这一箭我留到它踏步落地。
lines.en: I save this shot for when its foot lands
The arrow flies and finds the throat.
I step back and put in another arrow.

lines.zh: 近距离，我用弓身砸下去。
lines.en: At close range I swing the bow itself.

lines.zh: 它冲过来，我射它的膝盖。
lines.en: It charges; I shoot it in the knee.

lines.zh: 一箭穿过去，没给它喊的机会。
lines.en: One shot through, no chance to shout.
After the shot I move position.
My arrow is quicker than its blade.
It raises a shield; I aim at the seam.
Bad luck for it, this arrow.
I twist aside from its swing.

lines.zh: 它倒了，我再补一箭确认。
lines.en: It fell; one more arrow to be sure.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在颤，它已经不动。
lines.en: The fletching still quivers; it has stopped.
Even an empty bow can hurt someone.
My kin in the distance are already laughing.

lines.zh: 我贴着矮墙射，它找不到我。
lines.en: I shoot from behind the low wall where it cannot find me
It stops, and my arrow arrives

lines.zh: 我从林子边走出来，弓已经上弦。
lines.en: I step from the treeline, bow already strung.

lines.zh: 这一带的哨位该换人了。
lines.en: This watch post needs a new pair of eyes.
I appear over the fallen leaves, quiet.
Terrain first; we discuss the rest later.

lines.zh: 队伍到了，我找一个高点。
lines.en: The band has arrived; I find high ground.

lines.zh: 我出现在坡上，你们看不见。
lines.en: I appear on the slope where you cannot see.
This place is good for an ambush.
I settle my hood to hide my face.
Late again; the good spot is taken.

lines.zh: 我数了数，村里有六个门。
lines.en: I counted six doors in that village.

lines.zh: 风把我们的气味送过去了。
lines.en: The wind carries our scent to them.
Keep quiet and follow my lead.

lines.zh: 袖子烧起来，我就地打滚。
lines.en: My sleeve catches fire; I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 从坡上滑下来，膝盖磕了。
lines.en: I slid down the slope and hit my knee.
Water fills my hood and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 爆响之后，我只听见嗡声。
lines.en: After the burst I hear only a hum.

lines.zh: 他们也有弓，还射得更准。
lines.en: They have bows too, and shoot straighter.

lines.zh: 那股力量缠住我的手指。
lines.en: That force coils around my fingers.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，弦拉不满。
lines.en: Two days without food; I cannot draw full.

lines.zh: 闪电劈中我脚边的木桩。
lines.en: Lightning split the post at my feet.
The floor vanished and my fingers closed on air.
